title: Prevalence of Hepatitis B Virus Infection in Cameroon: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
abstract: ABSTRACT Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a global public health problem, and many regions of Sub‐Saharan Africa are disproportionately affected, including Cameroon, where prevalence has previously been shown to be high. This study aimed to provide up‐to‐date estimates of HBV prevalence in Cameroon. We searched Medline, Global Health, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Africa Index Medicus and the Journal of Health Science and Disease at the University of Yaounde. We included studies reporting HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) prevalence in the general population and subpopulations. A random‐effects meta‐analysis was used to generate pooled estimates of HBsAg prevalence, overall and for population subgroups including those considered at relatively higher‐risk and relatively lower‐risk of HBV infection. Heterogeneity was assessed using the index of heterogeneity ( I 2 ). Quality was assessed using the Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tool. Out of 1236 records, 92 papers with 100 studies were included in the meta‐analysis. Overall prevalence of HBV in Cameroon was 9.98% (95% confidence interval [CI] 9.00–11.02) with high heterogeneity ( I 2 = 98.10% ) . The prevalences for relatively lower‐risk and higher‐risk populations were8.94% (95% CI 7.84–10.11) and 12.70% (95% CI 10.28–15.32), respectively. In subgroup analyses, we found that sex, geographical area (regions), population risk groups and study design were the main sources of heterogeneity. Overall, HBV prevalence remains high in Cameroon. Our findings suggest an urgent need for health interventions to halt the spread of the disease, with particular attention needed for males and regions with the highest prevalence.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis provides updated estimates of hepatitis B virus (HBV) prevalence in Cameroon, reporting an overall prevalence of 9.98% with high heterogeneity. Subgroup analyses revealed lower prevalence in relatively lower-risk populations (8.94%) and higher prevalence in higher-risk groups (12.70%). Key sources of heterogeneity included sex, geographical area, population risk groups, and study design. The findings emphasize the urgent need for targeted health interventions, particularly for males and high-prevalence regions, to address the persistent high burden of HBV in Cameroon.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本系统回顾和荟萃分析重点关注喀麦隆的 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染,旨在提供一般人群和亚人群中 HBV 患病率 的最新估计。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该研究检索了 Medline、Global Health、Embase、Web of Science、Cochrane Library、Africa Index Medicus 以及雅温得大学的《健康科学与疾病杂志》。其中包括 92 篇论文和 100 项报告 HBsAg 患病率 的研究。使用随机效应荟萃分析来生成汇总估计值,使用 I2 评估异质性,并使用 Joanna Briggs Institute 关键评估工具评估质量。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 喀麦隆 HBV 总体 患病率 为 9.98%(95% CI 9.00-11.02),异质性较高(I2 = 98.10%)。患病率 在相对较低风险人群中较低(8.94%,95% CI 7.84–10.11),在相对较高风险人群中较高(12.70%,95% CI 10.28–15.32)。性别、地理区域、人口风险群体和研究设计被确定为异质性的主要来源。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究指出 HBV 患病率 估计值存在高度异质性 (I2 = 98.10%),其中性别、地理区域、人群风险群体和研究设计是关键来源。没有报道具体的争议,但高度异质性表明 患病率 估计值在不同亚组和地区之间存在差异。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果表明,喀麦隆迫切需要采取健康干预措施来阻止乙型肝炎病毒的传播,特别需要关注男性和 患病率 最高的地区。该研究强调了基于亚群体和地理差异的有针对性的公共卫生策略的重要性。

title_zh: 喀麦隆 患病率 感染的系统回顾和荟萃分析
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a global public health problem, and many regions of Sub‐Saharan Africa are disproportionately affected, including Cameroon, where prevalence has previously been shown to be high. This study aimed to provide up‐to‐date estimates of HBV prevalence in Cameroon. We searched Medline, Global Health, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Africa Index Medicus and the Journal of Health Science and Disease at the University of Yaounde. We included studies reporting HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) prevalence in the general population and subpopulations. A random‐effects meta‐analysis was used to generate pooled estimates of HBsAg prevalence, overall and for population subgroups including those considered at relatively higher‐risk and relatively lower‐risk of HBV infection. Heterogeneity was assessed using the index of heterogeneity ( I 2 ). Quality was assessed using the Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tool. Out of 1236 records, 92 papers with 100 studies were included in the meta‐analysis. Overall prevalence of HBV in Cameroon was 9.98% (95% confidence interval [CI] 9.00–11.02) with high heterogeneity ( I 2 = 98.10% ) . The prevalences for relatively lower‐risk and higher‐risk populations were8.94% (95% CI 7.84–10.11) and 12.70% (95% CI 10.28–15.32), respectively. In subgroup analyses, we found that sex, geographical area (regions), population risk groups and study design were the main sources of heterogeneity. Overall, HBV prevalence remains high in Cameroon. Our findings suggest an urgent need for health interventions to halt the spread of the disease, with particular attention needed for males and regions with the highest prevalence.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本系统回顾和荟萃分析重点关注喀麦隆的 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染,旨在提供一般人群和亚人群中 HBV 患病率 的最新估计。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该研究检索了 Medline、Global Health、Embase、Web of Science、Cochrane Library、Africa Index Medicus 以及雅温得大学的《健康科学与疾病杂志》。其中包括 92 篇论文和 100 项报告 HBsAg 患病率 的研究。使用随机效应荟萃分析来生成汇总估计值,使用 I2 评估异质性,并使用 Joanna Briggs Institute 关键评估工具评估质量。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 喀麦隆 HBV 总体 患病率 为 9.98%(95% CI 9.00-11.02),异质性较高(I2 = 98.10%)。患病率 在相对较低风险人群中较低(8.94%,95% CI 7.84–10.11),在相对较高风险人群中较高(12.70%,95% CI 10.28–15.32)。性别、地理区域、人口风险群体和研究设计被确定为异质性的主要来源。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究指出 HBV 患病率 估计值存在高度异质性 (I2 = 98.10%),其中性别、地理区域、人群风险群体和研究设计是关键来源。没有报道具体的争议,但高度异质性表明 患病率 估计值在不同亚组和地区之间存在差异。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果表明,喀麦隆迫切需要采取健康干预措施来阻止乙型肝炎病毒的传播,特别需要关注男性和 患病率 最高的地区。该研究强调了基于亚群体和地理差异的有针对性的公共卫生策略的重要性。

title: National guideline for hepatitis B elimination in Thailand: a decentralized health system model for expanding diagnosis and treatment
abstract: Despite sustained universal infant hepatitis B vaccination, chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains an important cause of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma in Thailand, particularly among adults born before vaccine implementation. This article summarizes the 2026 National Guideline on Elimination of Viral Hepatitis B in Thailand and presents a health-system framework for addressing the remaining disease burden. The guideline was developed by a multidisciplinary expert panel using evidence from international recommendations, peer-reviewed literature, national epidemiological data, implementation studies, and health economic analyses. The recommendations were formulated using the GRADE framework and adapted for implementation within Thailand's Universal Health Coverage system. The national strategy prioritizes birth-cohort HBsAg screening for adults born before 1992, simplified evidence-based treatment eligibility incorporating non-invasive fibrosis assessment and virological criteria, and first-line use of high genetic-barrier nucleos(t)ide analogs. Prevention of mother-to-child transmission prioritizes HBV DNA-guided antiviral prophylaxis, with simplified implementation pathways reserved for settings with substantial diagnostic constraints. Long-term care emphasizes structured monitoring, appropriate specialist referral, conservative treatment discontinuation criteria, defined retreatment thresholds, and risk-based semiannual ultrasound surveillance for hepatocellular carcinoma. Integration with antenatal services, HIV programs, and primary care facilities supports decentralized delivery and continuity of care. Thailand's 2026 hepatitis B guideline operationalizes evidence-based CHB management within a publicly financed decentralized health system and provides a scalable model for expanding hepatitis B diagnosis and treatment in endemic settings.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该范围研究了人类 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染、其慢性后遗症(肝硬化、肝细胞癌),以及如何通过分散的卫生系统模式在泰国消除 HBV 的核心问题,重点关注普遍婴儿 疫苗接种 实施之前出生的成年人。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该审查提出了 2026 年泰国消除病毒性乙型肝炎国家指南,该指南由多学科专家小组利用国际建议、同行评审文献、国家流行病学数据、实施研究和卫生经济分析中的证据制定,并使用 GRADE 框架制定并适应泰国全民健康覆盖体系的建议。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该指南优先考虑对 1992 年之前出生的成年人进行出生 队列研究 HBsAg 筛查,简化基于证据的 治疗 资格,纳入非侵入性纤维化评估和病毒学标准,一线使用高遗传屏障核苷(酸)类似物,HBV DNA 指导的 抗病毒药物 预防母婴 传播,结构化采用保守的 治疗 停药标准和基于风险的半年一次超声 监测 进行肝细胞癌长期护理。

title: Risk of Virological Failure After Switch to a Tenofovir-Sparing Dual Therapy in Virologically Suppressed People With HIV and Past HBV Infection.
abstract: We compared the effectiveness of tenofovir (TFV)-based triple regimens (TT) to TFV-sparing dual therapies (DT) in virologically suppressed, HBsAg-/HBcAb+ people living with HIV (PLWH). We emulated a target trial including adults PLWH from five University Hospitals, with HBsAg-/HBcAb+ serostatus, starting a TT with unsuppressed serum HIV-RNA and reaching HIV-RNA 50 cp/mL or a single HIV-RNA ≥ 200 cp/mL) were estimated through a weighted Kaplan-Meier estimator. Overall, 415 PLWH were eligible for study analysis: 71 (17.1%) started a DT (3TC-based: 78.9%) during follow-up. They were mainly men (329, 79.3%), with a median age of 48 years. In the weighted analysis, the estimated probabilities of VF were: 29.3% for DT and 29.9% for TT at 5 years (difference: 0.5%; 95% CI: -28.7, +21.6). A higher VF risk was seen in the subset of PLWH with undetectable HBsAb at the longest follow-up available (4 years), independently of treatment group: 15.5% and 36.8% with DT and TT, respectively (difference: -21.3%; 95% CI: -30.3, -13.8). Switch to a TFV-sparing DT, compared with continuing a TT, was not associated with an increased risk of VF in PLWH and prior HBV infection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to compare the effectiveness of tenofovir (TFV)-based triple regimens (TT) to TFV-sparing dual therapies (DT) in virologically suppressed people living with HIV (PLWH) with past HBV infection, specifically those who were HBsAg-/HBcAb+.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was an emulation of a target trial including adults with HIV from five University Hospitals, who were HBsAg-/HBcAb+ and had virologically suppressed HIV-RNA, with 415 PLWH eligible for analysis, of whom 71 (17.1%) started a DT during follow-up.
analysis.methods: The study used a weighted Kaplan-Meier estimator to estimate the probabilities of virological failure (VF), defined as two consecutive HIV-RNA > 50 cp/mL or a single HIV-RNA ≥ 200 cp/mL, at 5 years.
analysis.main_results: In the weighted analysis, the estimated probabilities of VF were 29.3% for DT and 29.9% for TT at 5 years (difference: 0.5%; 95% CI: -28.7, +21.6). A higher VF risk was seen in the subset with undetectable HBsAb at the longest follow-up (4 years): 15.5% and 36.8% with DT and TT, respectively (difference: -21.3%; 95% CI: -30.3, -13.8).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that switching to a TFV-sparing DT, compared with continuing a TT, was not associated with an increased risk of VF in PLWH with prior HBV infection, providing new evidence for treatment options in this population.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform clinical practice by suggesting that TFV-sparing dual therapy may be a viable option for virologically suppressed PLWH with past HBV infection, potentially reducing long-term toxicity without increasing VF risk.

analysis.summary_en: This study compared tenofovir (TFV)-based triple regimens (TT) to TFV-sparing dual therapies (DT) in virologically suppressed people living with HIV (PLWH) with past HBV infection (HBsAg-/HBcAb+). Among 415 eligible participants, 71 (17.1%) started a DT during follow-up. The weighted analysis showed no significant difference in virological failure (VF) risk at 5 years between DT (29.3%) and TT (29.9%; difference: 0.5%; 95% CI: -28.7, +21.6). However, a higher VF risk was observed in those with undetectable HBsAb at 4 years (DT: 15.5% vs. TT: 36.8%; difference: -21.3%; 95% CI: -30.3, -13.8). The authors concluded that switching to TFV-sparing DT is not associated with increased VF risk, offering a potentially safer alternative for this population.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是对一项目标试验的模拟,包括来自五家大学医院的 HIV 感染者,他们的 HBsAg-/HBcAb+ 且 HIV-RNA 病毒学受到抑制,415 名 PLWH 符合分析条件,其中 71 名 (17.1%) 在随访期间开始接受 DT。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在比较基于替诺福韦 (TFV) 的三联疗法 (TT) 与保留 TFV 的双重疗法 (DT) 对既往感染过 HBV 且病毒学受到抑制的 HIV 感染者 (PLWH) 的有效性,特别是那些 HBsAg-/HBcAb+ 的患者。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,与继续 TT 相比,转为保留 TFV 的 DT 与既往感染 HBV 的 PLWH 的 VF 风险增加无关,这为该人群中的 治疗 选择提供了新的证据。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为临床实践提供了信息,表明保留 TFV 的双重疗法可能是病毒学抑制的既往 HBV 感染的 PLWH 的可行选择,有可能减少长期毒性而不增加 VF 风险。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是对目标试验的模拟,可能会引入无法测量的混杂因素,但大样本量和稳健的统计分析为结果提供了适度的可信度。

title: Clinical and virological characteristics of hepatitis B virus genotype E infection: a case series
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) genotype E, mainly found in sub-Saharan Africa, exhibits low genetic diversity, unique molecular markers and high recombination potential but remains under-studied. AIM: This study describes the clinical and virological characteristics, mutational profiles, antiviral treatment responses and phylogenetic data of patients with confirmed HBV genotype E infection in a tertiary-care centre in northern Italy. METHODS: A retrospective monocentric study was conducted at ASST Spedali Civili di Brescia, Italy, from 2015 to 2023. Patients with documented HBV genotype E who underwent genotypic resistance testing (GRT) for clinical reasons were included. Direct sequencing of the S/POL region was used for genotyping and mutation analysis, interpreted via Geno2pheno [hbv] 2.0 and Stanford HBV resistance tools. RESULTS: Eight patients were identified, mostly male (62.5%) and of African origin (87.5%), with a median age of 38.5 years. GRT was performed in six (75%) patients because of persistent viremia despite antiviral treatment, five (83.3%) of whom were HIV/HBV coinfected with detectable HIV viral load. Lamivudine resistance mutations (L180M, M204V) were found in one (12.5%) case, tenofovir resistance-associated mutations (M267L/I) in two (25%) and immune escape mutations in three (37.5%), including T126I, D144E and G145R. Despite GRT, treatment was not modified in four (50%) patients due to poor adherence concerns. Therapy adjustments led to viral suppression in three (37.5%) cases. CONCLUSION: In our setting, HBV genotype E infections largely occurred among migrants from endemic regions. Although nucleos(t)ide analogues are effective across genotypes, suboptimal adherence may hinder viral suppression and promote resistance.

title: Distribution of hepatitis B virus genotypes and demography in the general population of Karachi, Sindh
abstract: Hepatitis B is a major global burden, with 253 million infected people. There are at least ten Hepatitis B virus (HBV) genotypes and 35 subgenotypes, with distinct ethno-geographical distributions and manifest differences in their biological characteristics, display close association with clinical outcomes, severity of disease, and response to antiviral therapy. The aim of the study was to identify the predominant circulating genotypes of HBV in the population of Karachi, Sindh. A demographic assessment was conducted alongside a serological evaluation of markers specifically HBsAg, HBsAb, HBeAb, and HBcAb to determine the clinical infection profile of the study cohort. An initial molecular identification was performed by first round of PCR via specific primers P1 and S1-2 for PreS1/S2 gene. The HBV genotypes (A to F) was determined by nested PCR using primer pairs for the conserved sequence of HBV pre-S gene and S gene, and subsequently validated by phylogenetic analysis. The study findings indicated that the mean age of the study participants was 33.94 years, with a median age of 31.5 years. The percentage of HBV positive female and male were 51.5% and 48.5%, respectively. The results of this pilot study indicated that the probable predominant genotype circulating in Karachi is D, followed by B and C. Mixed infection of B, C, and D was also observed. Almost all the D positive samples were positive for HBsAg.

title: Validation of a Point‐Of‐Care Ultrasound for Hepatitis Among Front‐Line Healthcare Workers Managing Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infection in Zambia
abstract: ABSTRACT To close gaps in implementing care of people with hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in resource‐limited settings, we evaluated the accuracy of a novel liver point‐of‐care ultrasound (POCUS) protocol for hepatitis (PUSH) among front‐line non‐radiology healthcare workers in Zambia. At University Teaching Hospital in Lusaka, Zambia, from March to June 2024, we trained four nurses and six physicians with experience in HBV management, but not in ultrasound (US), in the PUSH protocol, which includes visualizing the liver in three windows (epigastric, subcostal and right transcostal) to identify cirrhosis‐suggestive features and liver lesions suspicious for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Then, consecutive adult participants with chronic hepatitis B (PWHB) alone or HBV/HIV coinfection underwent PUSH with operators blinded to clinical data. We evaluated the accuracy of PUSH for significant fibrosis and cirrhosis using transient elastography (TE) as the reference standard test (RST) and for liver lesions that were possible HCC using a comprehensive abdominal ultrasound by an experienced radiographer as the RST. Nonparametric analysis of the receiver operating curve (ROC) for PUSH was adjusted for operator type (doctor vs. nurse), sex and HIV status. Among 197 PWHBs analysed, 69.5% were taking HBV antivirals and 27.9% had HBV/HIV. According to RSTs, 17.7% of PWHBs had significant fibrosis, 11.6% had cirrhosis and 3.5% had liver lesions. PUSH had low accuracy for significant fibrosis, with sensitivity of 8.3% (17.5–41.4), specificity of 100.0% (96.1–100) and an area under the curve (AUROC) of 0.54 (0.43–0.65), moderate accuracy for cirrhosis, with sensitivity of 60.9% (38.5–80.3), specificity of 97.7% (94.2–99.4) and AUROC of 0.79 (0.69–0.89), and higher accuracy for liver lesions, with 85.7% (42.1–99.6) sensitivity, 98.4% (95.5–99.7) specificity, AUROC of 0.92 (0.78–1.00). After an expedited training, front‐line nurses and physicians treating HBV in Zambia were able to use PUSH to diagnose cirrhosis with moderate accuracy and liver lesions with high accuracy, although confidence intervals around performance estimates were wide. Liver POCUS including PUSH may be useful in HBV management when laboratory systems and TE are lacking.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains under-managed in resource-limited settings due to gaps in diagnostic capacity, prompting the need for accessible point-of-care tools. The study aimed to evaluate whether a novel liver point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) protocol (PUSH) could accurately identify significant fibrosis, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) lesions in adults with chronic HBV managed by front-line healthcare workers.
analysis.study_design_and_population: At University Teaching Hospital in Lusaka, Zambia, from March to June 2024, four nurses and six physicians with HBV management experience but no prior ultrasound training were trained in the PUSH protocol. Consecutive adults with chronic HBV, including those with HBV/HIV coinfection, underwent PUSH with operators blinded to clinical data.
analysis.methods: PUSH involved visualizing the liver in three windows (epigastric, subcostal, and right transcostal) to identify cirrhosis-suggestive features and HCC lesions. Accuracy for significant fibrosis and cirrhosis was assessed against transient elastography (TE) as the reference standard, while liver lesions were compared to comprehensive abdominal ultrasound by an experienced radiographer. Nonparametric ROC analysis adjusted for operator type, sex, and HIV status was used.
analysis.main_results: Among 197 participants, 17.7% had significant fibrosis, 11.6% had cirrhosis, and 3.5% had liver lesions by reference standards. PUSH showed low accuracy for significant fibrosis (sensitivity 8.3%, specificity 100.0%, AUROC 0.54), moderate accuracy for cirrhosis (sensitivity 60.9%, specificity 97.7%, AUROC 0.79), and high accuracy for liver lesions (sensitivity 85.7%, specificity 98.4%, AUROC 0.92).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that after expedited training, front-line nurses and physicians could use PUSH to diagnose cirrhosis with moderate accuracy and liver lesions with high accuracy, despite wide confidence intervals. They highlighted the potential utility of liver POCUS, including PUSH, in HBV management where laboratory systems and TE are unavailable.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest PUSH could support decentralized HBV care in low-resource settings by enabling front-line providers to screen for cirrhosis and HCC lesions, potentially improving early detection and linkage to treatment when advanced imaging is inaccessible.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s small sample size and wide confidence intervals limit precision, and the training duration was expedited, which may not reflect real-world retention of skills. The evidence is moderate due to these constraints and the single-centre design.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated a novel point-of-care ultrasound protocol (PUSH) for detecting significant fibrosis, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) lesions in adults with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection managed by front-line healthcare workers in Zambia. After brief training, nurses and physicians used PUSH to assess liver disease with moderate accuracy for cirrhosis (sensitivity 60.9%, specificity 97.7%, AUROC 0.79) and high accuracy for HCC lesions (sensitivity 85.7%, specificity 98.4%, AUROC 0.92), though performance for significant fibrosis was low (AUROC 0.54). The authors propose PUSH as a practical tool for HBV care in settings lacking laboratory infrastructure or transient elastography. Limitations include a small sample size, wide confidence intervals, and a single-centre design, warranting larger, multi-centre validation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于诊断能力的差距,慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染在资源有限的环境中仍然管理不善,这促使需要可用的护理点工具。该研究旨在评估新型肝脏即时超声 (POCUS) 方案 (PUSH) 是否能够准确识别由一线医护人员管理的慢性乙型肝炎成人患者中的显着纤维化、肝硬化和肝细胞癌 (HCC) 病变。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 3 月至 6 月,在赞比亚卢萨卡大学教学医院,四名护士和六名医生接受了 PUSH 方案的培训,这些护士具有 HBV 管理经验,但之前没有接受过超声培训。连续患有慢性 HBV 的成年人,包括 HBV/HIV 双重感染的患者,在不了解临床数据的操作员的情况下接受了 PUSH。
elements_zh.methods: PUSH 涉及在三个窗口(上腹、肋下和右经肋)观察肝脏,以识别肝硬化提示特征和 HCC 病变。以瞬时弹性成像 (TE) 作为参考标准评估显着纤维化和肝硬化的准确性,同时由经验丰富的放射技师将肝脏病变与综合腹部超声进行比较。使用根据操作员类型、性别和 HIV 状况进行调整的非参数 ROC 分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 根据参考标准,197 名参与者中,17.7% 患有明显纤维化,11.6% 患有肝硬化,3.5% 患有肝脏病变。PUSH 对显着纤维化的准确性较低(敏感性 8.3%,特异性 100.0%,AUROC 0.54),对肝硬化的准确性中等(敏感性 60.9%,特异性 97.7%,AUROC 0.79),对肝脏病变的准确性较高(敏感性 85.7%,特异性 98.4%,AUROC 0.92)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,经过快速培训后,一线护士和医生可以使用 PUSH 以中等准确度诊断肝硬化,并以较高准确度诊断肝脏病变,尽管置信区间较宽。他们强调了肝脏 POCUS(包括 PUSH)在实验室系统和 TE 不可用的 HBV 管理中的潜在效用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,PUSH 可以通过使一线提供者能够筛查肝硬化和 HCC 病变来支持资源匮乏环境中的分散式 HBV 护理,从而有可能改善早期检测以及在无法获得高级成像时与 治疗 的联系。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的样本量小和置信区间宽限制了精度,并且训练时间加快,这可能无法反映现实世界中技能的保留情况。由于这些限制和单中心设计,证据是中等的。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于诊断能力的差距,慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染在资源有限的环境中仍然管理不善,这促使需要可用的护理点工具。该研究旨在评估新型肝脏即时超声 (POCUS) 方案 (PUSH) 是否能够准确识别由一线医护人员管理的慢性乙型肝炎成人患者中的显着纤维化、肝硬化和肝细胞癌 (HCC) 病变。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 3 月至 6 月,在赞比亚卢萨卡大学教学医院,四名护士和六名医生接受了 PUSH 方案的培训,这些护士具有 HBV 管理经验,但之前没有接受过超声培训。连续患有慢性 HBV 的成年人,包括 HBV/HIV 双重感染的患者,在不了解临床数据的操作员的情况下接受了 PUSH。
analysis_zh.methods: PUSH 涉及在三个窗口(上腹、肋下和右经肋)观察肝脏,以识别肝硬化提示特征和 HCC 病变。以瞬时弹性成像 (TE) 作为参考标准评估显着纤维化和肝硬化的准确性,同时由经验丰富的放射技师将肝脏病变与综合腹部超声进行比较。使用根据操作员类型、性别和 HIV 状况进行调整的非参数 ROC 分析。
analysis_zh.main_results: 根据参考标准,197 名参与者中,17.7% 患有明显纤维化,11.6% 患有肝硬化,3.5% 患有肝脏病变。PUSH 对显着纤维化的准确性较低(敏感性 8.3%,特异性 100.0%,AUROC 0.54),对肝硬化的准确性中等(敏感性 60.9%,特异性 97.7%,AUROC 0.79),对肝脏病变的准确性较高(敏感性 85.7%,特异性 98.4%,AUROC 0.92)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,经过快速培训后,一线护士和医生可以使用 PUSH 以中等准确度诊断肝硬化,并以较高准确度诊断肝脏病变,尽管置信区间较宽。他们强调了肝脏 POCUS(包括 PUSH)在实验室系统和 TE 不可用的 HBV 管理中的潜在效用。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,PUSH 可以通过使一线提供者能够筛查肝硬化和 HCC 病变来支持资源匮乏环境中的分散式 HBV 护理,从而有可能改善早期检测以及在无法获得高级成像时与 治疗 的联系。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的样本量小和置信区间宽限制了精度,并且训练时间加快,这可能无法反映现实世界中技能的保留情况。由于这些限制和单中心设计,证据是中等的。

title: Nucleos(t)ide withdrawal vs Nucleos(t)ide withdrawal with adjuvant pegylated-interferon in HBeAg-negative hepatitis B virus infection (NUC-B Trial).
abstract: BACKGROUND: Finite therapy resulting in sustained hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss for patients with chronic HBV infection (CHB) is an important therapeutic goal. In patients with HBeAg-negative infection, nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) withdrawal may achieve HBsAg loss in 5-20% of patients after 3 years. Pegylated interferon (PEG-IFNa) is a recognised treatment for CHB. METHODS: NUC-B was a randomised, multi-centre trial in NA-treated non-cirrhotic HBeAg negative patients with CHB. Patients were allocated to either NA withdrawal alone (control) or NA withdrawal followed by a 16 week course of PEG-IFNa 180ug weekly commencing 4 weeks after NA cessation (PEG-IFNa). The primary endpoint was HBsAg loss at 3 years. RESULTS: The target recruitment of 240 patients was not achieved. 156 patients, 82 to control arm , 74 to PEG-IFNa arm , were recruited between 2017 and 2021; median age 45 years, 24% female, HBV Genotypes -A 16%, B 6%, C 4%, D 24%, E 22%, other 1%, unknown 26%. At 3 years 3% of patients in the contol arm and 14% of patients in the PEG-IFNa arm lost HBsAg (odds ratio 5.39; 95% confidence interval, (1.11, 26.19); p=0.037). In the control arm 34.9% of patients returned to NA therapy compared to 28.4% in the PEG_IFNa- arm. Exaggerated flares occurred in 27.9% of patients in the control arm compared with 13.4% in the PEG-IFNa arm. CONCLUSIONS: The use of adjuvant PEG-IFNa therapy after withdrawal of NA therapy increases the rate of HBsAg loss whilst simultaneously reducing the number of exaggerated flares.

analysis.summary_en: The NUC-B trial investigated whether adding pegylated interferon (PEG-IFNa) to nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) withdrawal improves outcomes in HBeAg-negative chronic hepatitis B patients. In this randomized multi-center study, 156 patients were assigned to NA withdrawal alone or NA withdrawal followed by 16 weeks of PEG-IFNa. At 3 years, 14% of the PEG-IFNa group achieved HBsAg loss compared to 3% in the control group (OR 5.39; 95% CI 1.11-26.19; p=0.037). The PEG-IFNa group also had fewer exaggerated flares (13.4% vs 27.9%) and similar rates of returning to NA therapy. The study suggests that adjuvant PEG-IFNa after NA withdrawal significantly increases HBsAg loss while reducing liver flares, though the trial was underpowered with only 156 of 240 planned patients recruited.

title: Differential Hepatitis B Surface Antigen Glycan Isomer Kinetics Between Tenofovir Alafenamide and Entecavir: Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk Stratification in Hepatitis B e Antigen-Positive Patients.
abstract: Nucleos(t)ide analog (NA) therapy suppresses hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA, but residual hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk persists. O-glycosylated hepatitis B surface antigen glycan isomer (HBsAgGi) uniquely reflects virion burden. We evaluated the impact of tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) versus entecavir (ETV) on 48-week HBsAgGi kinetics and its utility in stratifying HCC risk in 90 NA-naïve patients (ETV: 73; TAF: 17). A favourable response was defined as a reduction or maintenance of low HBsAgGi levels. TAF independently predicted a favourable response compared with ETV (penalised odds ratio 3.60, p = 0.030). A significant interaction occurred between HBeAg status and HBsAgGi response in relation to HCC development (p = 0.038). In HBeAg-positive patients, a poor response was associated with increased HCC risk (hazard ratio 7.34, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.96-20.35, p = 0.001); however, the exact magnitude warrants cautious interpretation due to wide CIs. This association was absent in HBeAg-negative cases. Adding HBsAgGi response to the aMAP score improved long-term HCC prediction exclusively in the HBeAg-positive cohort. As the assay targets genotype C-specific O-glycosylation, the findings cannot be generalised to genotypes A, B, or D. In conclusion, on-treatment HBsAgGi response is a specific surrogate marker for stratifying residual HCC risk in HBeAg-positive patients, and TAF is more effective than ETV in inducing these favourable kinetics.

title: Trends in Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C, and HIV Seroprevalence in the Netherlands: Insights From Two Decades of Nationwide PIENTER Serosurveys.
abstract: Hepatitis B (HBV), hepatitis C (HCV), and HIV remain public health challenges despite effective treatments and preventive options. Infections are often asymptomatic, leading to undiagnosed cases, onward transmission, and preventable morbidity and mortality. In the Netherlands, disease burden is concentrated in specific populations, with many undetected infections. We estimated HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence, identified determinants, and assessed trends over 20 years using data from 14,444 participants aged 15-79 years from three nationwide cross-sectional serosurveys (PIENTER: 1995-1996, 2006-2007, and 2016-2017). Participants completed questionnaires on demographics, behaviour, and socio-economic factors, and serum samples were tested for HBV and HCV in all rounds and HIV in 2017. Seroprevalence estimates were weighted to the Dutch population, trends were analysed using weighted Poisson regression, and determinants were evaluated using multivariable Poisson regression. Weighted HBV seroprevalence remained stable across surveys (3%-5% past or present infection; < 0.4% active infection). HBV prevalence was highest among first-generation migrants, with older age, migration background, and STI history as key determinants. HCV seroprevalence remained low (< 0.4%) and was highest among non-Western migrants. HIV prevalence was 0.1% and highest among non-Western migrants and men who have sex with men. Only 9% of active HBV cases were aware of their status. Overall, HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence remain low in the Netherlands but are concentrated in specific groups with limited awareness. analysis.research_question_and_background: Hepatitis B (HBV), hepatitis C (HCV), and HIV remain public health challenges despite effective treatments and preventive options, with infections often asymptomatic leading to undiagnosed cases and onward transmission. In the Netherlands, the disease burden is concentrated in specific populations with many undetected infections, necessitating an assessment of seroprevalence trends over time.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study utilized data from three nationwide cross-sectional serosurveys (PIENTER: 1995-1996, 2006-2007, and 2016-2017) including 14,444 participants aged 15-79 years to estimate HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence, identify determinants, and assess trends over 20 years.
analysis.methods: Participants completed questionnaires on demographics, behaviour, and socio-economic factors, and serum samples were tested for HBV and HCV in all rounds and HIV in 2017. Seroprevalence estimates were weighted to the Dutch population, trends were analysed using weighted Poisson regression, and determinants were evaluated using multivariable Poisson regression.
analysis.main_results: Weighted HBV seroprevalence remained stable across surveys (3%-5% past or present infection; < 0.4% active infection), was highest among first-generation migrants, and only 9% of active HBV cases were aware of their status. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Overall, HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence remain low in the Netherlands but are concentrated in specific groups with limited awareness, indicating that while general population prevalence is stable, persistent transmission risks exist within these subpopulations.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings support targeted prevention, screening, and linkage-to-care strategies to achieve the 2030 WHO elimination goals and highlight the importance of continued population-based (sero-)monitoring to guide public health policy.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed three nationwide cross-sectional serosurveys (PIENTER) from 1995-1996, 2006-2007, and 2016-2017, involving 14,444 participants aged 15-79 years, to assess trends in HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence in the Netherlands. Weighted analyses showed that HBV seroprevalence remained stable (3%-5% past or present infection; < 0.4% active infection), HCV stayed low (< 0.4%), and HIV prevalence was 0.1%. Infections were concentrated among first-generation and non-Western migrants and men who have sex with men, with only 9% of active HBV cases aware of their status. These findings support targeted prevention and screening strategies to achieve WHO elimination goals and underscore the need for continued population-based monitoring.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管有有效的 传播 和预防措施,乙型肝炎 (HBV)、丙型肝炎 (HCV) 和 HIV 仍然是公共卫生挑战,感染通常无症状,导致未确诊病例和进一步的 传播。在荷兰,疾病负担集中在特定人群中,有许多未发现的感染,因此需要对 血清流行率 随着时间的推移的趋势进行评估。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用了三项全国性横断面血清调查(PIENTER:1995-1996、2006-2007 和 2016-2017)的数据,包括 14,444 名 15-79 岁的参与者,以估计 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 血清流行率、确定决定因素并评估 20 年来的趋势。
elements_zh.methods: 参与者完成了有关人口统计、行为和社会经济因素的问卷调查,并在 2017 年对所有轮次的 HBV 和 HCV 以及 HIV 样本进行了血清样本检测。血清流行率 估计值根据荷兰人口进行加权,使用加权泊松回归分析趋势,并使用多变量泊松回归评估决定因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 加权 HBV 血清流行率 在整个调查中保持稳定(3%-5% 过去或现在感染;< 0.4% 活动性感染),在第一代移民中最高,只有 9% 的活动性 HBV 病例知道自己的状况。HCV 血清流行率 仍然较低(< 0.4%),在非西方移民中最高,而 HIV 患病率 为 0.1%,在非西方移民和男男性行为者中最高。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 总体而言,荷兰的HBV、HCV和HIV 血清流行率仍然较低,但集中在认知有限的特定群体中,这表明虽然一般人群患病率稳定,但在这些亚群中存在持续的传播风险。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持有针对性的预防、筛查和与护理挂钩的战略,以实现世卫组织 2030 年消除目标,并强调持续进行基于人群的(血清)监测以指导公共卫生政策的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据没有报告具体的设计限制、偏差或混杂因素,但使用二十年来三项大规模全国性调查的加权数据为评估人口趋势提供了中等水平的证据。

title: Hepatitis B virus Seroprevalence Among Heterosexual Couples Attending Antenatal Care at Gulu Regional Referral Hospital, Uganda
abstract: Background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) is a global health concern and the leading cause of chronic liver disease, including liver cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. The Uganda Ministry of health recommends screening of HBV for all pregnant mothers during antenatal care (ANC). However, limited literature exists regarding couple testing and outcomes, particularly in Northern Uganda. Objective We determined HBV seroprevalence and associated factors among pregnant women and their partner attending ANC clinic of Gulu Regional Referral hospital (GRRH), Gulu, Uganda. Methods Between 1st December 2023 and 28th February 2024, a hospital-based, cross-sectional study was conducted among eligible pregnant women and their male partners attending ANC of GRRH, Gulu, Uganda. Following systematic random sampling, pretested questionnaire was administered by an interviewer. Blood samples were collected for HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) rapid test, which was performed according to manufacturer’s instructions. Qualitative data was analysed using logistic regression in STATA version 15 SE. P<0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results A total of 242 couple pairs were enrolled. Overall, 8.3% (n=40) participants were seropositive for HBsAg; Male partners [M] (10.7%, n=26) and pregnant women [F] (5.8%, n=14). Sero-concordance (M negative [-ve] and F [-ve]; 83.5%, n=202), (M positive [+ve] and F [+ve]; 4.1%, n=10) and sero-discordance (M +ve and F -ve; 8.7%, n=21), (M -ve and F +ve; 3.7%, n=9). Factors associated with positive HBsAg were, being male (adjusted odds ratio [aOR]: 2.45, 95% Confidence Interval [CI], 1.15 - 5.21, p=0.02), daily alcohol consumption (aOR: 4.73, 95% CI: 1.40 -16.04, p=0.01), and no prior vaccination against HBV (aOR: 12.01, 95% CI: 4.07 - 35.65, p<0.001). Conclusion There is a high HBsAg seropositivity rate, particularly among male partners of pregnant women. There is an urgent need to have couples who come for ANC to be screened for HBV and to strengthen and sensitise young people for premarital HBV screening.

title_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 血清流行率 乌干达古卢地区转诊医院接受产前护理的异性夫妇
source_body_en: Background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) is a global health concern and the leading cause of chronic liver disease, including liver cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. The Uganda Ministry of health recommends screening of HBV for all pregnant mothers during antenatal care (ANC). However, limited literature exists regarding couple testing and outcomes, particularly in Northern Uganda. Objective We determined HBV seroprevalence and associated factors among pregnant women and their partner attending ANC clinic of Gulu Regional Referral hospital (GRRH), Gulu, Uganda. Methods Between 1st December 2023 and 28th February 2024, a hospital-based, cross-sectional study was conducted among eligible pregnant women and their male partners attending ANC of GRRH, Gulu, Uganda. Following systematic random sampling, pretested questionnaire was administered by an interviewer. Blood samples were collected for HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) rapid test, which was performed according to manufacturer’s instructions. Qualitative data was analysed using logistic regression in STATA version 15 SE. P<0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results A total of 242 couple pairs were enrolled. Overall, 8.3% (n=40) participants were seropositive for HBsAg; Male partners [M] (10.7%, n=26) and pregnant women [F] (5.8%, n=14). Sero-concordance (M negative [-ve] and F [-ve]; 83.5%, n=202), (M positive [+ve] and F [+ve]; 4.1%, n=10) and sero-discordance (M +ve and F -ve; 8.7%, n=21), (M -ve and F +ve; 3.7%, n=9). Factors associated with positive HBsAg were, being male (adjusted odds ratio [aOR]: 2.45, 95% Confidence Interval [CI], 1.15 - 5.21, p=0.02), daily alcohol consumption (aOR: 4.73, 95% CI: 1.40 -16.04, p=0.01), and no prior vaccination against HBV (aOR: 12.01, 95% CI: 4.07 - 35.65, p<0.001). Conclusion There is a high HBsAg seropositivity rate, particularly among male partners of pregnant women. There is an urgent need to have couples who come for ANC to be screened for HBV and to strengthen and sensitise young people for premarital HBV screening.

title: Exploration of Hepatitis B Virus Infection Dynamics through Physics-Informed Deep Learning Approach
abstract: Accurate forecasting of viral disease outbreaks is crucial for guiding public health responses and preventing widespread loss of life. Recently, Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have emerged as a promising framework for capturing viral infection dynamics and predicting their future progression. Standard PINNs are effective in simulating disease dynamics through forward modeling approach; however, they often face challenges in estimating key biological parameters from sparse or noisy data in inverse problems. To overcome these limitations, a recent extension, known as Disease-Informed Neural Networks (DINNs), has gained attention as a robust framework for parameter estimation. In this work, we apply this DINN technique to a recently proposed hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection dynamics model to predict the transmission of infection within the liver. The model consists of four compartments: uninfected and infected hepatocytes, relaxed circular DNA (rcDNA)-containing capsids, and free viruses. Before estimating the parameters, a structural identifiability analysis is performed to determine the identifiable parameters of this model. Then, we study the impacts of (i) variations in parameter ranges, (ii) experimental noise, (iii) sample size, (iv) network architecture, and (v) learning rate on the performance of DINNs. Furthermore, using experimental data from nine HBV-infected chimpanzees, we observe that DINNs can estimate unknown parameters, capture infection dynamics, and predict disease progression even when experimental data for some model compartments are not available. Additionally, DINNs identify the model parameters that vary significantly across chimpanzees. A global sensitivity analysis is further performed, and the results indicate that significant parameters are consistent with those detected by DINNs. Finally, comparison with nonlinear least-squares fitting and maximum likelihood estimation demonstrates the advantages of DINNs in parameter estimation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 准确预测病毒性疾病 暴发 对于指导公共卫生应对措施和防止广泛的生命损失至关重要。物理信息神经网络(PINN)已成为捕获病毒感染动态并预测其未来进展的有前途的框架。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究将疾病知情神经网络 (DINN) 应用于 传播 (HBV) 感染动力学模型,以预测肝脏内的 传播。该模型由四个部分组成:未感染和感染的肝细胞、含有松弛环状 DNA (rcDNA) 的衣壳和游离病毒。该分析使用了九只感染 HBV 的黑猩猩的实验数据。
elements_zh.methods: 在估计参数之前,进行结构可识别性分析以确定可识别参数。该研究考察了参数变化、实验噪声、样本大小、网络架构和学习率对 DINN 性能的影响。进行全局敏感性分析,并将结果与​​非线性最小二乘拟合和最大似然估计进行比较。
elements_zh.main_results: 即使某些模型区室的实验数据不可用,DINN 也可以估计未知参数、捕获感染动态并预测疾病进展。该方法识别出黑猩猩之间差异显着的参数,并且 DINN 检测到的重要参数与全局敏感性分析中的参数一致。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将 DINN 解释为病毒感染动力学参数估计的稳健框架,克服了标准 PINN 在逆问题中的局限性。新颖之处在于将 DINN 应用于 HBV 感染动态,并通过稀疏或嘈杂的数据证明其有效性。

analysis_en.methods: Before estimating parameters, a structural identifiability analysis is performed to determine identifiable parameters. analysis_en.main_results: DINNs can estimate unknown parameters, capture infection dynamics, and predict disease progression even when experimental data for some model compartments are unavailable. title_zh: 通过物理信息深度学习方法探索 乙型肝炎病毒 感染动力学
source_body_en: Accurate forecasting of viral disease outbreaks is crucial for guiding public health responses and preventing widespread loss of life. Recently, Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have emerged as a promising framework for capturing viral infection dynamics and predicting their future progression. Standard PINNs are effective in simulating disease dynamics through forward modeling approach; however, they often face challenges in estimating key biological parameters from sparse or noisy data in inverse problems. To overcome these limitations, a recent extension, known as Disease-Informed Neural Networks (DINNs), has gained attention as a robust framework for parameter estimation. In this work, we apply this DINN technique to a recently proposed hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection dynamics model to predict the transmission of infection within the liver. The model consists of four compartments: uninfected and infected hepatocytes, relaxed circular DNA (rcDNA)-containing capsids, and free viruses. Before estimating the parameters, a structural identifiability analysis is performed to determine the identifiable parameters of this model. Then, we study the impacts of (i) variations in parameter ranges, (ii) experimental noise, (iii) sample size, (iv) network architecture, and (v) learning rate on the performance of DINNs. Furthermore, using experimental data from nine HBV-infected chimpanzees, we observe that DINNs can estimate unknown parameters, capture infection dynamics, and predict disease progression even when experimental data for some model compartments are not available. Additionally, DINNs identify the model parameters that vary significantly across chimpanzees. A global sensitivity analysis is further performed, and the results indicate that significant parameters are consistent with those detected by DINNs. Finally, comparison with nonlinear least-squares fitting and maximum likelihood estimation demonstrates the advantages of DINNs in parameter estimation.
abstract_zh: 准确预测病毒性疾病 暴发 对于指导公共卫生应对措施和防止广泛的生命损失至关重要。最近,物理信息神经网络(PINN)已成为捕获病毒感染动态并预测其未来进展的有前途的框架。标准 PINN 可通过正向建模方法有效模拟疾病动态;然而,他们经常面临从逆问题中的稀疏或噪声数据估计关键生物参数的挑战。为了克服这些限制,最近的一个扩展,称为疾病信息神经网络(DINN),作为参数估计的强大框架而受到关注。在这项工作中,我们将这种 DINN 技术应用于最近提出的 传播 (HBV) 感染动力学模型,以预测肝脏内感染的 传播。该模型由四个部分组成:未感染和感染的肝细胞、含有松弛环状 DNA (rcDNA) 的衣壳和游离病毒。在估计参数之前,进行结构可识别性分析以确定该模型的可识别参数。然后,我们研究 (i) 参数范围的变化、(ii) 实验噪声、(iii) 样本大小、(iv) 网络架构和 (v) 学习率对 DINN 性能的影响。此外,使用九只感染 HBV 的黑猩猩的实验数据,我们观察到 DINN 可以估计未知参数、捕获感染动态并预测疾病进展,即使某些模型区室的实验数据不可用。此外,DINN 还可以识别不同黑猩猩之间存在显着差异的模型参数。进一步进行了全局敏感性分析,结果表明显着参数与 DINN 检测到的参数一致。最后,与非线性最小二乘拟合和最大似然估计的比较证明了 DINN 在参数估计方面的优势。

title: Impact of Removing the Universal Hepatitis B Birth-Dose Vaccination in the US.
abstract: IMPORTANCE: In December 2025, the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) voted to replace the universal hepatitis B birth-dose recommendation with shared clinical decision-making for infants born to mothers who screen negative for hepatitis B surface antigen. Although the proposal would not alter recommendations for infants of unscreened mothers, historical data suggest that removing a universal birth-dose vaccine recommendation may reduce vaccination coverage in this group. OBJECTIVE: To estimate the impact of replacing universal hepatitis B virus (HBV) birth-dose vaccination with a targeted recommendation on neonatal and subsequent chronic HBV infections in the US. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: A compartmental model and simulated a US birth cohort (n = 3 659 289) under the 2 vaccine recommendations: universal birth-dose vaccination and targeted birth-dose vaccination vaccine recommendations, where the birth dose was recommended to infants of screened-positive or unscreened mothers and shared-decision making is recommended for infants of screened-negative mothers. Parameter values were literature derived and uncertainty was incorporated across 5000 iterations. These data were analyzed from September through November 2025. EXPOSURES: Birth-dose vaccine recommendations and birth-dose vaccination coverage among infants of unscreened mothers. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Numbers of neonatal and subsequent chronic HBV infections. RESULTS: With the current maternal HBV screening rate of 86%, the universal birth-dose vaccine recommendation resulted in a median of 1292 neonatal infections (95% percentile interval [PI], 670-2228). In comparison, the targeted birth-dose vaccine recommendation was associated with 628 additional neonatal infections (95% PI, 340-1034) when birth-dose vaccination coverage among infants of unscreened mothers was 10% (mirroring historic coverage declines under a targeted recommendation) and 69 additional infections (95% PI, -32 to 190) when coverage was 80% (mirroring levels under a universal recommendation.) To offset the excess infections under the targeted birth-dose vaccine recommendation, more than 100 000 additional pregnant individuals would need to be screened if the birth-dose vaccination coverage among infants of unscreened mothers was 80%, and more than 400 000 if coverage was 10%. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: Findings from this study indicate that the targeted birth-dose vaccine recommendation will likely increase neonatal infections unless maternal screening rises substantially or vaccination coverage among infants of unscreened mothers exceeds current levels. As historic data show such improvements are unlikely, these findings underscore the continued importance of universal screening and vaccination as complementary safeguards.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the impact of replacing universal hepatitis B birth-dose vaccination with a targeted recommendation in the US. Using a compartmental model simulating a birth cohort of 3,659,289 infants, the researchers found that the targeted policy would likely increase neonatal HBV infections unless maternal screening rates rise substantially or vaccination coverage among infants of unscreened mothers exceeds current levels. With an 86% maternal screening rate, universal vaccination prevented a median of 1,292 neonatal infections, while the targeted approach could lead to hundreds more infections depending on coverage rates. The study underscores the importance of universal screening and vaccination as complementary safeguards against HBV transmission.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 隔室模型模拟了美国 3,659,289 名婴儿在两个 疫苗 建议下的出生 队列研究:通用出生剂量 疫苗接种 和目标出生剂量 疫苗接种,参数值来自文献,并纳入了 5,000 次迭代的不确定性。
elements_zh.methods: 该模型使用孕产妇 HBV 筛查率和未筛查母亲的婴儿出生剂量 疫苗接种 覆盖率作为关键变量,比较了普遍与目标出生剂量 疫苗接种 建议下的结果。

title_zh: 美国取消通用乙型肝炎出生剂量 疫苗接种 的影响。
source_body_en: IMPORTANCE: In December 2025, the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) voted to replace the universal hepatitis B birth-dose recommendation with shared clinical decision-making for infants born to mothers who screen negative for hepatitis B surface antigen. Although the proposal would not alter recommendations for infants of unscreened mothers, historical data suggest that removing a universal birth-dose vaccine recommendation may reduce vaccination coverage in this group. OBJECTIVE: To estimate the impact of replacing universal hepatitis B virus (HBV) birth-dose vaccination with a targeted recommendation on neonatal and subsequent chronic HBV infections in the US. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: A compartmental model and simulated a US birth cohort (n = 3 659 289) under the 2 vaccine recommendations: universal birth-dose vaccination and targeted birth-dose vaccination vaccine recommendations, where the birth dose was recommended to infants of screened-positive or unscreened mothers and shared-decision making is recommended for infants of screened-negative mothers. Parameter values were literature derived and uncertainty was incorporated across 5000 iterations. These data were analyzed from September through November 2025. EXPOSURES: Birth-dose vaccine recommendations and birth-dose vaccination coverage among infants of unscreened mothers. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Numbers of neonatal and subsequent chronic HBV infections. RESULTS: With the current maternal HBV screening rate of 86%, the universal birth-dose vaccine recommendation resulted in a median of 1292 neonatal infections (95% percentile interval [PI], 670-2228). In comparison, the targeted birth-dose vaccine recommendation was associated with 628 additional neonatal infections (95% PI, 340-1034) when birth-dose vaccination coverage among infants of unscreened mothers was 10% (mirroring historic coverage declines under a targeted recommendation) and 69 additional infections (95% PI, -32 to 190) when coverage was 80% (mirroring levels under a universal recommendation.) To offset the excess infections under the targeted birth-dose vaccine recommendation, more than 100 000 additional pregnant individuals would need to be screened if the birth-dose vaccination coverage among infants of unscreened mothers was 80%, and more than 400 000 if coverage was 10%. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: Findings from this study indicate that the targeted birth-dose vaccine recommendation will likely increase neonatal infections unless maternal screening rises substantially or vaccination coverage among infants of unscreened mothers exceeds current levels. As historic data show such improvements are unlikely, these findings underscore the continued importance of universal screening and vaccination as complementary safeguards.

title: Longitudinal Patterns of Chronic Hepatitis B Care and Treatment Adherence in Australia: A National Linked Data Cohort Study.
abstract: Current uptake of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) treatment and care in Australia is well below target levels, leading to an ongoing burden of preventable liver disease and cancer. Understanding individual-level trajectories of care engagement and variation by sociodemographic factors is essential to guide efforts to improve access to and retention in care. This study analysed records of hepatitis B viral load (VL) testing and antiviral treatment provided through Australia's national health insurance system, which were linked to migration, death, and sociodemographic data from various government datasets. Treatment and VL testing by population group were assessed, and uptake was calculated using modelled estimates of the number living with CHB. VL testing frequency and treatment adherence based on scripts dispensed were also assessed. Of the estimated 219,800 people living with CHB in Australia in 2023, 118,334 (53.8%) received either VL testing or treatment during 2014-2023. Estimated uptake of VL testing and treatment uptake were lower among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and also varied by region of birth. Of the 81,360 who received any VL testing, only 17,352 (21.3%) received it regularly, while 31,715 (39.0%) had evidence of prior monitoring but no VL testing since 2019. The majority of those who initiated treatment continued therapy and received supply sufficient for adherence. This study shows that substantial gaps exist in CHB care in Australia, particularly in continued monitoring among those not on treatment. Disparities in uptake are evident by priority population. Re-engaging those lost to follow-up should be prioritised.

It highlights that current treatment and care uptake is below target levels, contributing to preventable liver disease and cancer. The analysis reveals disparities in VL testing and treatment among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander populations and by region of birth. elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项研究分析了通过澳大利亚国家健康保险系统提供的乙型肝炎病毒载量 (VL) 检测和 Z​​XQTERMNQXZ 治疗 记录,这些记录与来自各个政府数据集的移民、死亡和社会人口统计数据相关。
elements_zh.methods: 对人群的 治疗 和 VL 测试进行了评估,并使用慢性乙型肝炎患者人数的模型估计来计算吸收率。
elements_zh.main_results: 2023 年澳大利亚估计有 219,800 名慢性乙型肝炎患者,其中 118,334 人 (53.8%) 在 2014-2023 年期间接受了 VL 检测或 治疗。在接受任何 VL 检测的 81,360 人中,只有 17,352 人 (21.3%) 定期接受检测,而 31,715 人 (39.0%) 有先前监测的证据,但自 2019 年以来没有进行 VL 检测。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这项研究表明,澳大利亚在慢性乙型肝炎护理方面存在巨大差距,特别是在对未参加 治疗 的人群进行持续监测方面。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民对 VL 测试和 治疗 的估计采用率较低,并且因出生地区而异。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据并未报告研究设计的局限性。

title_zh: 澳大利亚 慢性乙型肝炎 护理和 治疗 依从性的纵向模式:国家关联数据 队列研究 研究。
source_body_en: Current uptake of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) treatment and care in Australia is well below target levels, leading to an ongoing burden of preventable liver disease and cancer. Understanding individual-level trajectories of care engagement and variation by sociodemographic factors is essential to guide efforts to improve access to and retention in care. This study analysed records of hepatitis B viral load (VL) testing and antiviral treatment provided through Australia's national health insurance system, which were linked to migration, death, and sociodemographic data from various government datasets. Treatment and VL testing by population group were assessed, and uptake was calculated using modelled estimates of the number living with CHB. VL testing frequency and treatment adherence based on scripts dispensed were also assessed. Of the estimated 219,800 people living with CHB in Australia in 2023, 118,334 (53.8%) received either VL testing or treatment during 2014-2023. Estimated uptake of VL testing and treatment uptake were lower among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and also varied by region of birth. Of the 81,360 who received any VL testing, only 17,352 (21.3%) received it regularly, while 31,715 (39.0%) had evidence of prior monitoring but no VL testing since 2019. The majority of those who initiated treatment continued therapy and received supply sufficient for adherence. This study shows that substantial gaps exist in CHB care in Australia, particularly in continued monitoring among those not on treatment. Disparities in uptake are evident by priority population. Re-engaging those lost to follow-up should be prioritised.

title: Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk Between Untreated Immune Tolerant Vs. Treated Immune Active Chronic Hepatitis B Patients.
abstract: The risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) between chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients in the untreated immune tolerant (U-IT) vs. treated immune active (T-IA) phases is not clear, and most data are in Asian populations. We aim to evaluate long-term risks of cirrhosis, HCC, and overall mortality between U-IT vs. T-IA CHB patients among a national cohort of U.S. We conducted a propensity score weighted analysis of Veterans with CHB who met criteria for U-IT or T-IA from 1/1/2010 to 12/31/2021 (with follow-up through 12/31/2024). Incidence of cirrhosis, HCC, or death were compared between U-IT and T-IA groups. A total of 591 U-IT and 555 T-IA CHB patients were identified (mean age 56.4-57.5 years, 45%-50% non-Hispanic white, 37%-40% African American, 9%-10% Asian, 25%-29% concurrent diabetes, 35%-39% with FIB-4 > 3.25). Over a median follow up of 6.4 years (IQR 3.0-10.4), incidence of HCC was significantly lower in U-IT patients vs. T-IA patients (0.28 vs. 0.54 per 100 person-years; HR 0.52, 95% CI 0.32-0.83, p = 0.007). However, the risk of cirrhosis or all-cause mortality was similar between both T-IA and U-IT CHB patients. Among a predominantly non-Asian cohort of adults with CHB, we observed that HCC risk was lower in U-IT patients compared to T-IA patients. While this contrasts with some studies in Asian countries, these data do emphasize the importance of prioritizing and ensuring timely therapy for CHB patients in the IA phase. However, routine treatment in IT patients remains controversial and more data are needed to better understand long-term outcomes.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) between chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients in the untreated immune tolerant (U-IT) vs. treated immune active (T-IA) phases is not clear, and most data are in Asian populations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: We conducted a propensity score weighted analysis of Veterans with CHB who met criteria for U-IT or T-IA from 1/1/2010 to 12/31/2021 (with follow-up through 12/31/2024). A total of 591 U-IT and 555 T-IA CHB patients were identified.
analysis.methods: Incidence of cirrhosis, HCC, or death were compared between U-IT and T-IA groups using a propensity score weighted analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study compared hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk between untreated immune tolerant (U-IT) and treated immune active (T-IA) chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients in a U.S. veteran cohort. Using propensity score weighted analysis of 591 U-IT and 555 T-IA patients followed for a median of 6.4 years, researchers found significantly lower HCC incidence in U-IT patients (0.28 vs. 0.54 per 100 person-years; HR 0.52, 95% CI 0.32-0.83). However, cirrhosis and mortality risks were similar between groups. These findings contrast with some Asian studies and emphasize the importance of timely therapy for immune active patients, while noting that routine treatment for immune tolerant patients remains controversial.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们对 2010 年 1 月 1 日至 2021 年 12 月 31 日期间符合 U-IT 或 T-IA 标准的慢性乙型肝炎退伍军人进行了倾向评分加权分析(随访至 2024 年 12 月 31 日)。总共确定了 591 名 U-IT 和 555 名 T-IA CHB 患者。
elements_zh.methods: 使用倾向评分加权分析比较 U-IT 组和 T-IA 组之间的肝硬化、HCC 或死亡的 发病率。
elements_zh.main_results: Over a median follow up of 6.4 years (IQR 3.0-10.4), incidence of HCC was significantly lower in U-IT patients vs. T-IA patients (0.28 vs. 0.54 per 100 person-years; HR 0.52, 95% CI 0.32-0.83, p = 0.007). However, the risk of cirrhosis or all-cause mortality was similar between both T-IA and U-IT CHB patients.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在主要为非亚裔的慢性乙型肝炎成人 队列研究 中,我们观察到与 T-IA 患者相比,U-IT 患者的 HCC 风险较低。虽然这与亚洲国家的一些研究形成鲜明对比,但这些数据确实强调了在 IA 阶段优先考虑并确保及时治疗 CHB 患者的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了在免疫活跃期及时治疗慢性乙型肝炎患者的重要性,尽管免疫耐受患者的常规 治疗 仍存在争议,并且需要更多数据来更好地了解长期结果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在主要非亚洲人 队列研究 中进行的,这可能会限制对亚洲人群的普遍适用性。尽管有倾向评分加权,但由于观察设计和潜在的残留混杂因素,证据强度中等。

title_zh: 未经治疗的免疫耐受者与免疫耐受者之间的肝细胞癌风险接受治疗的免疫活跃 慢性乙型肝炎 患者。
source_body_en: The risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) between chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients in the untreated immune tolerant (U-IT) vs. treated immune active (T-IA) phases is not clear, and most data are in Asian populations. We aim to evaluate long-term risks of cirrhosis, HCC, and overall mortality between U-IT vs. T-IA CHB patients among a national cohort of U.S. We conducted a propensity score weighted analysis of Veterans with CHB who met criteria for U-IT or T-IA from 1/1/2010 to 12/31/2021 (with follow-up through 12/31/2024). Incidence of cirrhosis, HCC, or death were compared between U-IT and T-IA groups. A total of 591 U-IT and 555 T-IA CHB patients were identified (mean age 56.4-57.5 years, 45%-50% non-Hispanic white, 37%-40% African American, 9%-10% Asian, 25%-29% concurrent diabetes, 35%-39% with FIB-4 > 3.25). Over a median follow up of 6.4 years (IQR 3.0-10.4), incidence of HCC was significantly lower in U-IT patients vs. T-IA patients (0.28 vs. 0.54 per 100 person-years; HR 0.52, 95% CI 0.32-0.83, p = 0.007). However, the risk of cirrhosis or all-cause mortality was similar between both T-IA and U-IT CHB patients. Among a predominantly non-Asian cohort of adults with CHB, we observed that HCC risk was lower in U-IT patients compared to T-IA patients. While this contrasts with some studies in Asian countries, these data do emphasize the importance of prioritizing and ensuring timely therapy for CHB patients in the IA phase. However, routine treatment in IT patients remains controversial and more data are needed to better understand long-term outcomes.

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们对 2010 年 1 月 1 日至 2021 年 12 月 31 日期间符合 U-IT 或 T-IA 标准的慢性乙型肝炎退伍军人进行了倾向评分加权分析(随访至 2024 年 12 月 31 日)。总共确定了 591 名 U-IT 和 555 名 T-IA CHB 患者。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用倾向评分加权分析比较 U-IT 组和 T-IA 组之间的肝硬化、HCC 或死亡的 发病率。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在主要为非亚裔的慢性乙型肝炎成人 队列研究 中,我们观察到与 T-IA 患者相比,U-IT 患者的 HCC 风险较低。虽然这与亚洲国家的一些研究形成鲜明对比,但这些数据确实强调了在 IA 阶段优先考虑并确保及时治疗 CHB 患者的重要性。

title: Factors Associated With Surface Antigen (HBsAg) Clearance in a Spanish Cohort of Chronic Hepatitis B Patients: Influence on the Long-Term Prognosis.
abstract: The objective is to identify factors that contribute to hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) clearance in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection in an unselected, long-term follow-up hepatitis B open cohort in southern Spain. A prospective open cohort study of 453 patients with CHB infection was recruited in the Liver Unit of the Internal Department of two hospitals in Málaga (Spain) between 1991 and 2022 to assess the incidence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) clearance during follow-up, identify factors related to it, and determine the influence that clearance had on the long-term prognosis. The duration of follow-up ranged from 0.5 to 36.08 years. A multivariate Cox regression analysis was conducted to identify factors associated with HBsAg clearance. The impact of clearance on long-term prognosis was evaluated using a combined prognostic end point: need for liver transplantation, liver complications, or liver-related mortality. The construction of time-to-event curves was achieved by employing the Kaplan-Meir method, with subsequent comparison of event occurrence between groups conducted via log-rank test. During the subsequent follow-up period, 96/453 patients (21.2%) lost surface antigen (1.96/100 patients per year). Multivariate Cox regression analysis identified as independent factors associated with HBsAg clearance: age at first assessment over 40 years: HR 2.21 (1.38-3.52); a baseline DNA HBV peak below 3.3log10 (< 2000 IU/mL): HR 3.44 (2.01-5.89); loss of hepatitis B e-antigen (HBeAg) during follow-up: HR 7.23 (3.87-13.50). The incidence of HBsAg clearance was 1.96 cases/100 patient-years. It was more frequent in patients older than 40 years, with baseline DNA-HBV below 3.3 log10 (< 2000 IU/mL), and in chronic HBeAg+ patients who lost HBeAg during follow-up. HBsAg clearance was associated with a better long-term hepatic prognosis.

title: Long-Term Clinical Outcomes of Kidney Transplantation from Hepatitis B Surface Antigen (HBsAg)-Positive Donors to HBsAg-Negative Recipients: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Real-World Studies
abstract: Background: The use of hepatitis B surface antigen-positive (HBsAg+) kidneys may expand the donor pool for transplantation. This study evaluated the incidence, risk factors, complications, organ function, and survival outcomes of transplants from HBsAg+ donors to HBsAg− recipients. Methods: A systematic search of five databases was conducted through 20 August 2023. Incidence was expressed with 95% confidence intervals (CIs); odds ratios (ORs) and hazard ratios (HRs) assessed risk factors and survival. Results: Sixteen studies were included. Donor-derived HBV infection occurred in 3.60% (21/583). Risk was higher in HBsAb-negative (OR: 6.67, 95% CI: 1.08–41.10) and HBcAb-negative recipients (OR: 12.96, 95% CI: 2.06–81.69). Abnormal liver function occurred in 35.18%, hepatitis in 3.07%, and hepatic failure in 0.84%. Liver and kidney function at 1–3 years were comparable between HBsAg+ and HBsAg− kidney recipients. Five- and ten-year graft survival (85.2%, 82.7%) and patient survival (93.0%, 91.4%) were similar to controls (p > 0.05). Conclusions: HBsAg+ kidneys can achieve acceptable long-term outcomes with appropriate antiviral prophylaxis and cautious recipient selection, though infection risk requires careful assessment. These findings supports the cautious and selective use of HBsAg-positive kidneys in appropriately selected recipients use and standardized HBV prophylaxis.

title: Early Thalamo-Striatal Functional Disconnection in HBV-Related Cirrhosis Despite Preserved Subcortical Network Topology
abstract: Abstract Hepatic encephalopathy is a common complication of cirrhosis, but the neural mechanisms of early cognitive dysfunction remain unclear. We investigated subcortical functional network alterations in 44 patients with HBV-related cirrhosis and 37 healthy controls using resting-state fMRI. Subcortical regions were parcellated into 50 subregions. Graph theoretical analysis and Network-Based Statistics (NBS) were applied. No significant group differences were found in global or nodal topological metrics after multiple comparison correction. However, NBS identified a significant subnetwork comprising 8 thalamo-striatal connections (component-level \(\:P=0.0381\)). No correlations were observed between connectivity strength and neuropsychological scores (PHES: \(\:r=0.359,p=0.056\); MoCA: \(\:r=0.129,p=0.506\)). These findings suggest that HBV-related cirrhosis is associated with selective thalamo-striatal disconnection despite preserved network topology, which may represent an early neural signature preceding overt cognitive impairment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探讨乙型肝炎相关肝硬化早期认知功能障碍的神经机制,特别关注皮质下功能网络的改变。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项横断面研究涉及 44 名 HBV 相关肝硬化患者和 37 名健康对照者,使用静息态功能磁共振成像来分析皮质下功能网络。
elements_zh.methods: 皮质下区域被分为 50 个子区域,并应用图论分析和基于网络的统计 (NBS) 来检查功能连接性。
elements_zh.main_results: 在全局或节点拓扑指标中没有发现显着的组间差异,但 NBS 确定了一个由 8 个丘脑-纹状体连接组成的显着子网(组件级别 P=0.0381)。连接强度和神经心理学评分之间没有观察到相关性。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因连通性和认知得分之间缺乏相关性而受到限制,并且由于横断面设计和缺乏纵向数据,证据强度中等。

title: Dynamic changes in non-invasive fibrosis scores as early predictors of deterioration in chronic hepatitis B
abstract: BACKGROUND AND STUDY AIMS: Non-invasive scores such as APRI, FIB-4, GPR and ALBI are commonly used to evaluate liver fibrosis and functional reserve in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). However, interpretation has predominantly focused on single-time measurements, and the prognostic value of short-term changes (delta scores) remains uncertain. This study evaluated whether one-year changes in these scores are associated with laboratory-based composite deterioration during routine follow-up of CHB patients. PATIENTS AND METHODS: This retrospective cohort included adult CHB patients with two laboratory assessments approximately 12 months apart. APRI, FIB-4, GPR and ALBI were calculated at baseline (T0) and follow-up (T1); delta values were defined as ΔScore = T1 - T0. Laboratory-based composite deterioration was defined as meeting ≥1 criterion based on albumin, total bilirubin, INR, or platelet count. Logistic regression models, adjusted for age, gender, HBV-DNA level, HBeAg status, and antiviral therapy assessed associations between delta scores and deterioration. ROC analysis evaluated discriminative performance. RESULTS: A total of 297 patients were included (56.9% male; median age 45 years). Laboratory-based composite deterioration occurred in 23.6%. Baseline non-invasive scores were not associated with deterioration, while ΔAPRI, ΔFIB-4 and ΔGPR were significant predictors. In multivariable analyses, each 0.1-unit increase corresponded to higher risk: ΔAPRI (aOR 1.55; p = 0.004), ΔFIB-4 (aOR 1.29; p < 0.001) and ΔGPR (aOR 1.86; p = 0.001). When standardized, ΔFIB-4 demonstrated the strongest association (aOR 7.32 per 1-SD increase). ΔFIB-4 also showed the best discrimination (AUC 0.730). CONCLUSION: One-year dynamic changes in non-invasive scores, particularly ΔFIB-4, provide additional and clinically relevant prognostic information for identifying early deterioration during routine follow-up. Incorporating delta score monitoring into clinical practice may help to detect laboratory-based deterioration at an earlier stage.

abstract_original: BACKGROUND AND STUDY AIMS: Non-invasive scores such as APRI, FIB-4, GPR and ALBI are commonly used to evaluate liver fibrosis and functional reserve in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). However, interpretation has predominantly focused on single-time measurements, and the prognostic value of short-term changes (delta scores) remains uncertain. This study evaluated whether one-year changes in these scores are associated with laboratory-based composite deterioration during routine follow-up of CHB patients. PATIENTS AND METHODS: This retrospective cohort included adult CHB patients with two laboratory assessments approximately 12 months apart. APRI, FIB-4, GPR and ALBI were calculated at baseline (T0) and follow-up (T1); delta values were defined as ΔScore = T1 - T0. Laboratory-based composite deterioration was defined as meeting ≥1 criterion based on albumin, total bilirubin, INR, or platelet count. Logistic regression models, adjusted for age, gender, HBV-DNA level, HBeAg status, and antiviral therapy assessed associations between delta scores and deterioration. ROC analysis evaluated discriminative performance. RESULTS: A total of 297 patients were included (56.9% male; median age 45 years). Laboratory-based composite deterioration occurred in 23.6%. Baseline non-invasive scores were not associated with deterioration, while ΔAPRI, ΔFIB-4 and ΔGPR were significant predictors. In multivariable analyses, each 0.1-unit increase corresponded to higher risk: ΔAPRI (aOR 1.55; p = 0.004), ΔFIB-4 (aOR 1.29; p < 0.001) and ΔGPR (aOR 1.86; p = 0.001). When standardized, ΔFIB-4 demonstrated the strongest association (aOR 7.32 per 1-SD increase). ΔFIB-4 also showed the best discrimination (AUC 0.730). CONCLUSION: One-year dynamic changes in non-invasive scores, particularly ΔFIB-4, provide additional and clinically relevant prognostic information for identifying early deterioration during routine follow-up. Incorporating delta score monitoring into clinical practice may help to detect laboratory-based deterioration at an earlier stage.

abstract_zh: 背景和研究目的:APRI、FIB-4、GPR 和 ALBI 等无创评分通常用于评估 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者的肝纤维化和功能储备。然而,解释主要集中在单次测量上,短期变化(增量分数)的预后价值仍然不确定。本研究评估了这些评分的一年变化是否与慢性乙型肝炎患者常规随访期间基于实验室的综合恶化有关。患者和方法:这项回顾性 队列研究 包括成年 CHB 患者,两次实验室评估相隔约 12 个月。在基线(T0)和随访(T1)时计算APRI、FIB-4、GPR和ALBI;增量值定义为 ΔScore = T1 - T0。基于实验室的复合恶化被定义为基于白蛋白、总胆红素、INR或血小板计数满足≥1个标准。根据年龄、性别、HBV-DNA 水平、HBeAg 状态和 抗病毒药物 治疗进行调整的逻辑回归模型评估了 delta 评分与恶化之间的关联。ROC 分析评估了判别性能。结果:总共纳入 297 名患者(56.9% 为男性;中位年龄 45 岁)。实验室复合材料劣化发生率为 23.6%。基线无创评分与病情恶化无关,而 ΔAPRI、ΔFIB-4 和 ΔGPR 是显着的预测因子。在多变量分析中,每增加 0.1 个单位对应更高的风险:ΔAPRI (aOR 1.55;p = 0.004)、ΔFIB-4 (aOR 1.29;p < 0.001) 和 ΔGPR (aOR 1.86;p = 0.001)。标准化后,ΔFIB-4 表现出最强的关联(每增加 1-SD,aOR 7.32)。ΔFIB-4 也表现出最好的辨别力(AUC 0.730)。结论:非侵入性评分(尤其是 ΔFIB-4)的一年动态变化为在常规随访期间识别早期恶化提供了额外的临床相关预后信息。将 delta 评分监测纳入临床实践可能有助于在早期阶段检测基于实验室的恶化。

title: Incidence of mother-to-child transmission of hepatitis B virus and associated factors in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia: a prospective cohort study
abstract: Viral hepatitis is a significant global public health challenge. Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) is accountable for the majority of the challenges. The main transmission mode of HBV in highly endemic countries is perinatal. However, there is limited evidence on the incidence of mother-to-child transmission (MTCT) and its associated factors in Ethiopia impacting the implementation of tailored control interventions. Thus, this study aimed to estimate the incidence of MTCT of HBV and its associated factors. A prospective observational cohort study was conducted among 110 infants born to hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)-positive mothers from February 2023 to February 2024 in selected public health facilities in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Follow-up evaluations were conducted at birth and at 9 months post-delivery. Socio-demographic and clinical characteristics of mother-infant pairs, and laboratory investigations were assessed to determine the incidence of MTCT and associated factors. Frequencies and percentages were used to summarize infant characteristics. Poisson regression model with robust standard errors was employed to identify factors associated with MTCT of HBV. The level of significance was set at P 200,000 IU/mL HBV DNA concentration. The incidence of MTCT of HBV was 9(8.2%) (95% CI: 4.0–15.4%). Infants who received only pentavalent vaccination starting at 6 weeks post-delivery were at risk to MTCT of HBV than infants received HepB-BD± HBIG vaccine ( P = 0.006). Maternal HBV viral load > 200,000 IU/mL ( P 200,000 IU/mL are essential to reduce the incidence of MTCT of HBV.

analysis.summary_en: This prospective cohort study in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, investigated the incidence of mother-to-child transmission (MTCT) of hepatitis B virus (HBV) and its associated factors among 110 infants born to HBsAg-positive mothers. The results highlight the importance of early vaccination with HepB-BD± HBIG and monitoring high viral loads to reduce MTCT, providing valuable evidence for tailored interventions in Ethiopia.

title: The Silent Burden of Hepatitis B-Related Stigma.
abstract: Individuals experiencing stigma related to chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection often experience negative self-beliefs, isolation, discrimination, and reduced willingness to engage with healthcare professionals. We aimed to understand the patient perspective of HBV-related stigma and to summarize the patient experience of stigma in a patient-centric conceptual model. Eligible adult participants with a confirmed diagnosis of chronic HBV infection were recruited from the US, China, and Poland. Qualitative, semi-structured, concept elicitation interviews of approximately 60 min were conducted to explore participants' experiences of stigma. Qualitative analysis of interview data was conducted using Thematic Analysis methods with concepts categorized into domains and pre-determined stigma types. A total of 28 participants were recruited from the US (n = 11), China (n = 11), and Poland (n = 6). Internalized stigma was reported by all participants (n = 28; 100%), social stigma was reported by 79% (n = 22) of participants, and institutional stigma was reported by 57% (n = 16) of participants. Seven domains across condition-specific and health-related quality of life (HRQoL) concepts were identified to create a patient-centric conceptual model of the experience of stigma associated with HBV infection. Each domain was reported by at least half of the participants, with social functioning (n = 28; 100%), emotional wellbeing (n = 27; 96%), and HBV transmission (n = 27; 96%) most frequently reported. Experiences of stigma were highly inter-related. Experiences of HBV-related stigma were highly pervasive, with widespread impact on HRQoL. To address the burden of stigma, reducing internalized stigma would be most impactful as this was the most common and bothersome.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染与耻辱相关,可能导致消极的自我认知、社会孤立、歧视和医疗保健参与度降低。该研究试图阐明患者对乙型肝炎相关耻辱的看法,并构建以患者为中心的这种经历的概念模型。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究招募了来自美国、中国和波兰的 28 名确诊慢性乙型肝炎病毒感染的成年人。进行了大约 60 分钟的半结构化定性访谈,以探索参与者的耻辱经历。
elements_zh.methods: 使用主题分析方法对定性概念引发访谈进行分析,并将污名概念分类为领域和预先确定的污名类型。从已确定的领域开发了以患者为中心的概念模型。
elements_zh.main_results: 所有 28 名参与者(100%)报告了内在的耻辱,22 名参与者(79%)报告了社会耻辱,16 名参与者(57%)报告了机构耻辱。确定了七个领域,其中最常报告的是社会功能 (100%)、情绪健康 (96%) 和 HBV 传播 (96%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将耻辱经历解释为高度普遍且相互关联,对健康相关的生活质量具有普遍影响。他们的结论是,由于其高 患病率 和令人烦恼的性质,减少内在耻辱将是最有影响力的。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调需要采取有针对性的干预措施来解决慢性乙型肝炎感染的内在耻辱感,这可能会提高患者对医疗保健的参与度和整体生活质量。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 小样本量(n = 28)和定性设计限制了普遍性,并且该研究并未包括来自所有乙肝病毒流行地区的参与者。由于这些限制,证据强度被评估为中等。
